marc:datafield.marc:subfield: LAIN daRI yaNg LAIN. EPISOD 5. SIRI 8.

Contains 3 segments: SEGMENT 1 The unique lifestyle of the Bajau Laut community, who build settlements on coral reefs and practice a primitive, nomadic way of life in the waters of Sabah. SEGMENT 2 The ability of a man to use his mouth to produce melodic and mesmerizing musical rhythms. He is also capable of mimicking bird calls and various genres of music. SEGMENT 3 The activity of catching coquina clams (remis), carried out by coastal communities as a side livelihood during their spare time.
